subject.title: Clarify status of optional bird transport

question: What is the supported public status and authoritative installation source for the `bird` helper used by Birdclaw?
rationale: Current released behavior actively supports and sometimes requires `bird`, but repository evidence cannot determine whether its unavailable public distribution should be restored, documented as private-only, or retired.

options.title: Restore public distribution
options.body: Keep the current transport behavior and publish or document an authoritative supported `bird` package or repository.

options.title: Make xurl public-primary
options.body: Document `bird` as private or legacy and ensure every public workflow either works through `xurl` or clearly states the limitation.

options.title: Retire bird with migration
options.body: Remove the integration only after replacing its unique workflows and documenting compatible upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Restore public distribution
recommendation.body: Keep the current transport behavior and publish or document an authoritative supported `bird` package or repository.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner authored the current released transport contract and is directly asked by the reporter to clarify it.
